items.title: UBS now expects AI capex to reach nearly $1tn this year and around $1.4tn by 2027

items.title: What Does Micron Technology (MU) Warning Of Shortages Through 2027 Mean?
items.summary: Micron Technology (NasdaqGS: MU) and Intel CEOs cautioned that memory chip shortages and higher prices could persist through 2027. Micron's leadership indicated on a recent call that supply constraints may only start to ease meaningfully from 2028 onward. Intel's CEO echoed the outlook for extended tightness in DRAM and NAND availability, pointing to heavy AI and data center demand. items.title: Netflix, Nucor, On Holding, Xenon, Accenture, Coinbase, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq Composite rebounded to end Friday’s session slightly higher after spending most of the day in the red.  The Dow Jones Industrial Average ended lower as higher oil prices and bond yields weighed on equities.  Glassmaker  Corning  and optical networking stocks  Coherent  and  Lumentum  rose, while chip manufacturer  Intel  fell 0.2%.
